# Anthropic TypeScript SDK license as shipped

This directory records the license text of `@anthropic-ai/sdk@0.129.0`
as it was found in the #56 inventory of a built FlyBot runtime image.
It is not a legal opinion.

The image contained this package at
`/usr/local/lib/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/sdk`,
with `package.json` declaring MIT and a `LICENSE` file of 1056 bytes,
sha256 `8bf96984ff8bcfae7e48cae76a529e8a25317ba9e02abf7fd3cc64fdf95657a6`.
The text is a standard MIT grant, Copyright 2023 Anthropic, PBC.

This is **not** `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk` and **not** the official
Claude Code platform payloads that DSH `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` lists as
“SEE LICENSE IN README.md” / “SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE.md”. Those packages
were not present in the scanned npm trees of that image. Do not read this
MIT text as those other terms.

The image recipe also copies this LICENSE to
`/opt/licenses/anthropic-sdk/LICENSE`.
